serverInfo.title: HOUSINGFAX
serverInfo.description: HOUSINGFAX: immediate home report for a building or flat in Spain, 22 checks from official and public sources (building condition record IEE/ITE, aluminosis probability, cadastre, flooding, ground motion, radon, market prices and more). Every report is free: the full report with web view and PDF, with the building condition assessment when a public registry holds the building's IEE/ITE.
